edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Firefighters repeatedly inhale combustion byproducts, PFAS, and shift-work circadian stressors, a bundle of exposures that may help explain higher prostate cancer rates.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2023 DeBono meta analysis in Saf Health Work, which ties firefighting occupation to prostate cancer in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
